OpenAI, Anthropic and Vercel all ship the same API keys page: a list of keys you can only see the end of, a dialog to make a new one, and a single chance to copy the secret. API keys is that page as one block that drops into any Settings section. It handles the parts that go wrong: secrets lost because a dialog closed, keys revoked by accident, and lists that jump when something leaves.
Pass onRotate to add Rotate key with a grace period for the old secret. Set undoTimeout to 0 to revoke the moment it’s confirmed, and pass resources, prefix and snippet to match your API.

Revoke the key. Runs after the undo window. Throw and the key comes back with Try again.

Revoking asks first, naming the key. Then the row collapses away and a toast offers Undo for five seconds, and onRevoke only runs once that window closes, so Undo needs nothing from your server. Leaving the page or creating another key sends any waiting revokes right away. Rotate key swaps in a new secret and can keep the old one working for an hour, a day or a week. Rename in place with F2 or a double-click, Enter to save and Escape to cancel.

generateApiKey uses crypto.getRandomValues, so it works in Node, edge runtimes and Workers. Store a hash and the last four characters, and send the secret back once.
